title: Friend View
description:
Follow a friend's co-op play in Slay the Spire 2 through a read-only view: combat and rewards, shops, dialogue, crystal-sphere predictions, rest sites, treasure, relic choices and supported card-selection screens.

[h2]Simple controls[/h2]
Click a friend in the left player list. Click again or use Esc / controller Cancel to return. When observation is unavailable, the normal player-details action is preserved.

In Settings > Friend View, Show Friend View Button enables a separate small eye beside each friend. Green means active, purple means loading. Battle and Rewards Only limits observation to the legacy scope. Both options are off by default. Native tooltips explain them; English and Russian captions are included.

[h2]Your friend's view[/h2]
Reward options belong to the observed player. Shops and event options come from their visible window state. The header shows their portrait, health, gold, potions, relics and deck count, with an icon-only badge. Card and potion arrows identify the target; consumed potions disappear. The deck button opens their deck. Map and settings open your own native screens; shared map marks remain synchronized by the game.

[h2]Observation[/h2]
You cannot play a friend's cards, buy their items, choose dialogue or claim their rewards. Your native End Turn action remains available. Cancel returns to your own hand. Unknown windows close observation automatically.

Supported activities render locally from installed game assets and bounded state updates, only while watched. Changes are coalesced to at most twice per second. No screen images or desktop capture are transmitted. Decorative animation phases may differ. New game versions and drawing methods require validation.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Every lobby member needs matching game and Friend View versions. Use the built-in loader; no additional loader or library is required. Avoid duplicate Workshop and manual installations.

[h2]Profiles and controllers[/h2]
When Friend View is the only successfully loaded cosmetic mod, the normal profile is used. With other mods or load errors, native modded-profile isolation remains. The choice is fixed until restart; no saves are copied or merged, and MODDED remains visible.

Native controller actions and glyphs follow remapping. Select enters or switches, Cancel exits, Confirm previews upgraded reward cards; in combat Confirm still belongs to your own End Turn action. Eye-button hints appear on the right.

Own code: MIT. Developed with OpenAI Codex. Native game assets belong to Mega Crit and are not redistributed.
